title: Focuslane Experiment Studio
features: Five same-URL query variants with browser-local random assignment, isolated headline/CTA/layout tests and provisional combined version; single-factor sandbox across twelve test dimensions; responsive product preview, validated local trial form, first-party local event metrics, click map and JSON export with eligibility guidance.
limits: No remote analytics, real trial, historical winner or proven benchmark. Local browser samples are not statistically representative; combined version is hypothetical, not a confirmed winner. No form values are persisted. Urgency and proof examples are labeled illustrative. Query variants remain distinct from custom sandbox metrics.
